description: Selectors/custom-properties whose hex literals are semantic UI state or neutral chrome, never brand surface — checkStructuralResidue must never flag these regardless of how close they are to a captured brand hex. Hand-curated once per base template; extend this file, never the check's logic, when a new legitimate semantic/neutral color is found. The neutral-chrome and neutral-icon entries below are template-inherent (identical on every demo): greys/whites/blacks in chrome, avatars, tooltips, spinners, scrollbars, dropdowns, checkbox borders, and monochrome UI icons that are never brand surfaces.
